name: Kalman Momentum Regime
concept: Estimates hidden price momentum with a Kalman filter and trades on regime shifts.
instructions: Apply a Kalman filter where observation is df['close'] and state vector is [price, momentum]; extract the filtered momentum series; compute its first difference; define bullish regime when momentum>0 and diff>0, bearish when momentum<0 and diff<0; generate a bull_signal when bullish regime starts (current bar true and previous bar false) inside session_mask(df,'london_ny'); generate bear_signal similarly; filter signals with rvol(df,20)>1.2 and adx(df,14)[0]>22; set sl_long = df['low']-1.5*atr(df,14), sl_short = df['high']+1.5*atr(df,14); enforce minimum risk of 2.5; compute tp1_long = df['close']+1.5*(df['close']-sl_long) and tp1_short = df['close']-1.5*(sl_short-df['close']).

name: Spectral Density Breakout
concept: Detects dominant frequency power spikes and trades when they exceed historical thresholds.
instructions: For each bar compute a rolling FFT on the last 120 closes (5‑minute data) using np.fft.rfft; calculate spectral power density; track the max power frequency; maintain a rolling mean and std of max power over 500 bars; create a breakout flag when current max power > mean+2*std; if breakout occurs during session_mask(df,'ny') and rvol(df,20)>1.3 and adx(df,14)[0]>25, set bull_signal when price is above its 20‑period EMA and bear_signal when below; set stops using 1.5*atr(df,14) as in prior entry and compute TP at 1.5R.

name: Hidden Markov Regime Switch
concept: Uses a two‑state HMM on returns to identify bullish or bearish hidden regimes.
instructions: Calculate log returns of df['close']; fit a Gaussian HMM with 2 hidden states on the last 1000 returns using hmmlearn (or implement EM manually); label the state with higher mean return as bullish; generate bull_signal when state switches to bullish and price closes above EMA(34) within session_mask(df,'london'); generate bear_signal on switch to bearish and close below EMA(34); require rvol(df,20)>1.2 and ADX>20; set stops and TP as per ATR‑based rules.

name: Wavelet Decomposition Trend
concept: Extracts the low‑frequency component via discrete wavelet transform to capture institutional trend.
instructions: Apply pywt.dwt on the last 256 closes with 'db4' wavelet; keep the approximation coefficients as the trend proxy; forward‑fill to align with original index; define bullish when trend proxy is rising for three consecutive bars and price closes above it; bearish when falling and price closes below; trigger signals only on first qualifying bar inside session_mask(df,'london_ny') and when rvol(df,20)>1.15 and efficiency_ratio(df['close'],20)>0.28; compute stops and TP using ATR buffer and 1.5R.

name: Shannon Entropy Volatility Filter
concept: Measures information entropy of price changes to separate high‑entropy breakout periods from low‑entropy consolidation.
instructions: Compute rolling histogram of 20‑bar returns with 10 bins; calculate Shannon entropy; maintain rolling mean and std of entropy over 500 bars; define high‑entropy regime when entropy > mean+1.5*std; in high‑entropy regime generate bull_signal if price closes above its 21‑EMA and bear_signal if below, only during session_mask(df,'ny'); require rvol(df,20)>1.2 and ADX>22; set stops and TP using 1.5*ATR and 1.5R.

name: Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis
concept: Uses MF‑DFA scaling exponent to detect persistent trending versus anti‑persistent ranging.
instructions: Implement MF‑DFA on the last 1024 closes to obtain scaling exponent h; forward‑fill h; treat h>0.55 as trending, h<0.45 as ranging; generate bull_signal when trending and price closes above 34‑EMA inside session_mask(df,'london'); generate bear_signal when trending and close below 34‑EMA; ignore ranging periods; require rvol(df,20)>1.2 and ADX>24; compute stops and TP with ATR buffer and 1.5R.

name: Dynamic EURUSD Copula Correlation
concept: Trades GBPUSD when its correlation with EURUSD deviates from a rolling copula‑based benchmark.
instructions: Assume a secondary DataFrame eurdf with same columns; compute rolling Pearson correlation of GBPUSD and EURUSD closes over 200 bars; fit a Gaussian copula to joint distribution of returns; calculate conditional probability of GBPUSD moving up given EURUSD up; if conditional probability exceeds 0.7 and GBPUSD close > its 55‑EMA during session_mask(df,'london_ny'), set bull_signal; if below 0.3 and close < 55‑EMA, set bear_signal; filter with rvol(df,20)>1.2 and ADX>22; set stops and TP using ATR and 1.5R.

name: Markov Switching Volatility Model
concept: Applies a two‑state Markov switching model on squared returns to identify high‑volatility regimes for breakout entries.
instructions: Estimate a Markov switching autoregressive model on squared returns using statsmodels; label state with higher variance as volatile; generate bull_signal when volatile state begins and price closes above 20‑EMA within session_mask(df,'ny'); generate bear_signal on volatile start with close below 20‑EMA; require rvol(df,20)>1.25 and ADX>23; compute stops and TP with 1.5*ATR and 1.5R.

name: Fractal Dimension Trend Filter
concept: Calculates the Higuchi fractal dimension to differentiate institutional trends from noise.
instructions: Compute Higuchi fractal dimension on the last 200 closes (kmax=10); forward‑fill fd; treat fd<1.4 as trending, fd>1.6 as noisy; generate bull_signal when trending and price closes above 34‑EMA inside session_mask(df,'london'); generate bear_signal when trending and close below 34‑EMA; require rvol(df,20)>1.2 and ADX>22; set stops and TP using ATR buffer and 1.5R.

name: Singular Value Decomposition Trend Extraction
concept: Uses SVD on a price matrix to isolate the dominant trend component for signal generation.
instructions: Construct a matrix of overlapping 30‑bar windows of closes; apply np.linalg.svd; take the first left singular vector as trend proxy; forward‑fill to original index; define bullish when trend proxy slope >0 for three bars and price closes above it; bearish when slope <0 and close below; trigger only on first bar of condition inside session_mask(df,'london_ny'); filter with rvol(df,20)>1.15 and ADX>21; compute stops and TP with 1.5*ATR and 1.5R.

name: Lyapunov Exponent Breakout
concept: Estimates the largest Lyapunov exponent to gauge chaos and trades when chaos drops indicating emerging order.
instructions: Calculate rolling largest Lyapunov exponent on the last 300 closes using Rosenstein method; forward‑fill le; define low‑chaos regime when le < mean(le[-500:]) - 0.5*std(le[-500:]); generate bull_signal if low‑chaos and price closes above 55‑EMA inside session_mask(df,'ny'); generate bear_signal if low‑chaos and close below 55‑EMA; require rvol(df,20)>1.2 and ADX>22; set stops and TP with ATR buffer and 1.5R.

name: GARCH‑Volatility Regime Entry
concept: Uses a rolling GARCH(1,1) forecast to identify volatility compression and subsequent expansion breakouts.
instructions: Fit a GARCH(1,1) model on the last 500 returns using arch package; forecast next‑day variance; compute volatility compression when forecast variance < rolling mean variance *0.7; on compression bar, if price closes above 20‑EMA during session_mask(df,'london'), set bull_signal; if below 20‑EMA, set bear_signal; require rvol(df,20)>1.2 and ADX>23; compute stops and TP with 1.5*ATR and 1.5R.

name: Phase‑Space Reconstruction Momentum
concept: Reconstructs phase space of price to detect attractor transitions signaling institutional moves.
instructions: Create delayed vectors of closes with embedding dimension 3 and delay 2; compute Euclidean distance between successive vectors; calculate average distance over 50 bars as a proxy for phase‑space expansion; define expansion when avg distance > rolling mean + 1.5*std; on expansion bar, if price > 34‑EMA inside session_mask(df,'london_ny'), set bull_signal; if price < 34‑EMA, set bear_signal; filter with rvol(df,20)>1.2 and ADX>22; set stops and TP using ATR buffer and 1.5R.

name: K‑Means Price Cluster Breakout
concept: Clusters recent price levels with K‑Means and trades when price exits the dominant cluster.
instructions: Run KMeans with k=4 on the last 200 closes; assign each bar to a cluster; identify dominant cluster as the one with most members; generate bull_signal when price moves from dominant cluster to a higher‑priced cluster and closes above 21‑EMA during session_mask(df,'ny'); generate bear_signal when moving to lower‑priced cluster and closes below 21‑EMA; require rvol(df,20)>1.2 and ADX>22; compute stops and TP with 1.5*ATR and 1.5R.

name: Bayesian Change‑Point Detection
concept: Applies Bayesian online change‑point detection on returns to spot structural breaks for entry.
instructions: Implement Bayesian online change‑point detection on log returns with hazard rate 1/250; obtain posterior probability of a change point; when probability exceeds 0.8 on a bar and price closes above 55‑EMA inside session_mask(df,'london'), set bull_signal; if below 55‑EMA, set bear_signal; require rvol(df,20)>1.2 and ADX>22; set stops and TP using 1.5*ATR and 1.5R.
